summary: Frontend-only web-preview check of: AI solutions kept for offline, the offline reader, the Class 11/12 per_page=100 view, /api/app/switches, and an offline Rapid Fire smoke, plus a code read of background.ts and client.ts sessionHandle. New script /app/tests/iter153_ai_offline_check.py: 17 of 18 checks pass. The one failure comes from the stub's shape, not the app (see minor). offline_rapid_check.py small: 33/33. The account was used READ-ONLY: no write touched attempts, start or profile; no Solutions tab was opened; no Start was tapped. BLOCKER FOUND AND CLEARED (environment, not app code): the Metro cache /app/frontend/.metro-cache held an OLD backendUrl (https://jeelive-feature-book--3o05z2vs.preview.emergentagent.com) baked into the expo-constants manifest. So the preview bundle called the old domain, CORS blocked every /api call and sign-in was impossible. I moved the cache to /tmp/metro-cache-stale-iter153; after Expo restarted, the bundle uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (revise-offline--6pwtbzuy) and everything works. No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch; the app uses expo-background-task ~58.0.13 and expo-task-manager).

action_items: ENV: after a fork or a preview-domain change, the Metro cache keeps the old EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL inside app.config extra.backendUrl, which breaks sign-in on the preview (CORS). Clear /app/frontend/.metro-cache (or start Expo with --clear) when the domain changes. Check the production build uses the correct URL.
LOW: papers.ts saveAi: use Number(data.total) || items.length for `total`.
LOW: app/offline/result.tsx:90: use the singular wording when aiCount === 1.

RISK (code read): client.ts sessionHandle refuses to make a new handle only when AppState === 'background'. A locked iPhone or a headless launch can report 'inactive' or 'unknown' (background.ts already treats everything except 'active' as closed). Use `AppState.currentState !== 'active'` so a refused Keychain read can never mint a new handle and sign the phone out.

RISK (code read): background.ts awaits syncBank(who.uid) without .catch. A bank sync failure throws, so that run skips keepResults (papers) entirely. Consider `.catch(() => {})` as sendRounds already has.
RISK (code read): catalogueAll caps pages at 10. While the website ignores per_page (12 a page), a subject with more than 120 chapters would be cut silently. Fine today (max 30).
critical_code_review_comments: background.ts is correct on the points asked. It returns when AppState is 'active'. It needs offlineIdentity (7-day stamp, not signed out) AND /auth/session with the same uid; a user:null or different uid fetches nothing. It makes only GETs plus sendRounds. An 8-minute timer and the iOS expiration listener call stopKeeping (an AbortController). Switch background=0 calls scheduleKeeping(false), which unregisters the task.

noteConfirmed in the background run renews the 7-day stamp without the student opening the app. This is by design (the server confirmed it), but it means the 7 days count from the last background confirmation, not the last time the app was opened.

scheduleKeeping(true) does not unregister an already-registered task when the switch is 0 while the app is open. The unregister happens only at the next background run. This matches the documented 'at its next run'.

rca_of_issue: Sign-in failing on the preview: the transformed expo-constants manifest in .metro-cache (file f8/db5578…) embedded extra.backendUrl from the previous preview domain. Metro's cache key did not change with the env value, so the bundle kept calling jeelive-feature-book--3o05z2vs and CORS rejected it. Fix: clear the Metro cache and restart Expo.
